extracted.name: Corn Black Bean Avocado Salsa
extracted.description: This corn black bean & avocado salsa is loaded with flavor. It's perfect as a chip dip or side salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 and 1/2 cups (270g) fresh, canned (and drained), or frozen (and thawed) corn kernels
1 and 1/2 cups (270g) cooked/canned black beans, drained and rinsed (about 1 can)
optional: 1 small jalapeño pepper, seeded and chopped
instruction_lines: Add everything to a large bowl. Stir. Taste and add more salt/pepper/cayenne if desired.
Cover and let sit in the refrigerator for 1 hour or up to 1 day before enjoying. I find its flavor is best after an hour or so. (The lime juice and red onion keep the avocado from turning brown.)
